newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hindalco to cut aluminium output - paper.
newsitem.headline: India's Hindalco to cut aluminium output - paper.

text.p: Hindalco Industries Ltd, India's largest private aluminium maker, has decided to cut its output in 1996/97 due to large inventories, an Indian newspaper said on Saturday.
The Economic Times newspaper said the company would reduce its output from the targeted 173,000 tonnes, but the size of the cut had yet to be finalised.
The newspaper, quoting company officials, said lower aluminium prices on the London Metal Exchange had led to large-scale imports by users in the past two months, and Hindalco's stocks had risen.
Hindalco's aluminium stocks during April-November were put at 11,000 tonnes compared with 3,000 in the same period last year, the newspaper said.
The company produced 108,000 tonnes of primary aluminium during April-November against 115,000 in the same period last year.
